flags.message: Chest symptoms that started suddenly may need urgent in-person assessment. This is not a diagnosis.
Sudden severe headache or stroke-like symptoms may need urgent assessment. This is not a diagnosis.
Reported bleeding should be reviewed promptly by a clinician. This is not a diagnosis.
Severe breathing difficulty may need urgent care. This is not a diagnosis.
If you are in crisis, contact local emergency services or a trusted person immediately. This tool cannot provide emergency care.
